تنافرت (form VI)
# تَنَافَرْتُ (tanāfartu) /ta.naː.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
# تَنَافَرْتَ (tanāfarta) /ta.naː.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
# تَنَافَرْتِ (tanāfarti) /ta.naː.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
# تَنَافَرَتْ (tanāfarat) /ta.naː.fa.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
